title: Daily sales
desc: Completed orders only, grouped by Nairobi calendar day. Revenue = items + delivery fees.
sql: SELECT {{DAY:o.created_at}} AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.items_subtotal) AS items, SUM(COALESCE(o.delivery_fee,0)) AS delivery, SUM(o.total) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(o.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS aov, SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfilment = 'pickup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pickup_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.fulfilment <> 'pickup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivery_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY {{DAY:o.created_at}} ORDER BY day

title: Sales by branch
desc: Completed orders by branch.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.total) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(o.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS aov FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY COALESCE(o.branch,'') ORDER BY revenue DESC

title: Sales by product
desc: Item-level performance from completed orders.
sql: SELECT oi.name AS name, COALESCE(oi.unit,'') AS unit, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY oi.name, COALESCE(oi.unit,'') ORDER BY revenue DESC

title: Sales by payment method
desc: Completed orders by how the customer paid.
sql: SELECT o.payment_method AS method, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.total) AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY revenue DESC

title: Sales ledger (completed orders)
desc: One row per completed order: the accountant's ledger.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, COALESCE(p.name,'Azizo own') AS partner, o.fulfilment, o.payment_method, COALESCE(o.mpesa_receipt,'') AS mpesa_receipt, o.status, o.items_subtotal, COALESCE(o.delivery_fee,0) AS delivery_fee, o.total, COALESCE(o.promo_code,'') AS promo_code, (SELECT MIN(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) AS t0, (SELECT MAX(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id AND l.status = 'completed') AS t1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN mk_partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) AND o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY o.id

title: All orders
desc: Every order in the period with its current status and minutes from order to completion.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, COALESCE(p.name,'Azizo own') AS partner, o.fulfilment, o.payment_method, COALESCE(o.mpesa_receipt,'') AS mpesa_receipt, o.status, o.items_subtotal, COALESCE(o.delivery_fee,0) AS delivery_fee, o.total, COALESCE(o.promo_code,'') AS promo_code, (SELECT MIN(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) AS t0, (SELECT MAX(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id AND l.status = 'completed') AS t1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN mk_partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) ORDER BY o.id

title: Closed orders (completed)
desc: Orders that were delivered or collected, with fulfilment time.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, COALESCE(p.name,'Azizo own') AS partner, o.fulfilment, o.payment_method, COALESCE(o.mpesa_receipt,'') AS mpesa_receipt, o.status, o.items_subtotal, COALESCE(o.delivery_fee,0) AS delivery_fee, o.total, COALESCE(o.promo_code,'') AS promo_code, (SELECT MIN(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) AS t0, (SELECT MAX(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id AND l.status = 'completed') AS t1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN mk_partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) AND o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY o.id

title: Open orders (still in progress)
desc: Not yet completed or cancelled, with age in minutes at the time of export.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, COALESCE(p.name,'Azizo own') AS partner, o.fulfilment, o.payment_method, COALESCE(o.mpesa_receipt,'') AS mpesa_receipt, o.status, o.items_subtotal, COALESCE(o.delivery_fee,0) AS delivery_fee, o.total, COALESCE(o.promo_code,'') AS promo_code, (SELECT MIN(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) AS t0, (SELECT MAX(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id AND l.status = 'completed') AS t1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN mk_partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) AND o.status IN ('received','preparing','ready','out_for_delivery') ORDER BY o.id

title: Unsuccessful orders
desc: Cancelled orders and orders whose M-Pesa payment failed (and were not completed). Value is the sale that was lost.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, COALESCE(p.name,'Azizo own') AS partner, o.fulfilment, o.payment_method, COALESCE(o.mpesa_receipt,'') AS mpesa_receipt, o.status, o.items_subtotal, COALESCE(o.delivery_fee,0) AS delivery_fee, o.total, COALESCE(o.promo_code,'') AS promo_code, (SELECT MIN(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) AS t0, (SELECT MAX(l.changed_at) FROM order_status_log l WHERE l.order_id = o.id AND l.status = 'completed') AS t1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN mk_partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id WHERE (o.status = 'cancelled' OR (o.status <> 'completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mpesa_transactions m WHERE m.order_id = o.id AND m.status = 'failed'))) AND o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) ORDER BY o.id

title: Order line items
desc: One row per item sold, for basket analysis.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.created_at, COALESCE(o.branch,'') AS branch, o.status, oi.product_id, oi.name, COALESCE(oi.unit,'') AS unit, oi.qty, oi.unit_price, oi.line_total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR o.branch = :branch) ORDER BY o.id, oi.id

title: User accounts (registered customers)
desc: Registered shop accounts with their order history. Passwords are never exported.
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.phone, c.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed') AS completed, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total),0) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed') AS spend, (SELECT MAX(o.created_at) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS last_order FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at >= :from AND c.created_at < :to ORDER BY c.id

title: Buyers (everyone who ordered)
desc: Unique phone numbers that ordered in the period, with or without an account. Useful for repeat-rate and lifetime value.
sql: SELECT SUBSTR(o.customer_phone, -9) AS phone9, MAX(o.customer_name) AS name, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN o.total ELSE 0 END) AS spend, MIN(o.created_at) AS first_order, MAX(o.created_at) AS last_order, MAX(CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS has_account FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.customer_phone, -9) ORDER BY spend DESC

title: Team and staff accounts
desc: Admin, manager, finance and counter logins (no passwords).
sql: SELECT username, name, role, active, last_login, created_at, COALESCE(created_by,'') AS created_by FROM team_accounts ORDER BY id

title: Visitors per day
desc: Unique visitors (anonymous, per-day) and page views. Excludes staff pages and bots.
sql: SELECT v.day, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vid) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.device = 'mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.device <> 'mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_views FROM site_visits v WHERE v.day >= :fromd AND v.day <= :tod GROUP BY v.day ORDER BY v.day

title: Pages viewed
desc: Most viewed pages.
sql: SELECT v.path, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vid) AS visitors FROM site_visits v WHERE v.day >= :fromd AND v.day <= :tod GROUP BY v.path ORDER BY views DESC

title: Traffic sources
desc: Where visitors came from (referrer or utm_source).
sql: SELECT v.source, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vid) AS visitors FROM site_visits v WHERE v.day >= :fromd AND v.day <= :tod GROUP BY v.source ORDER BY views DESC

title: Devices
desc: Phone, tablet or computer.
sql: SELECT v.device, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vid) AS visitors FROM site_visits v WHERE v.day >= :fromd AND v.day <= :tod GROUP BY v.device ORDER BY views DESC

title: Conversion funnel by day
desc: Visit, cart, checkout, order counts from the shop, with step conversion.
sql: SELECT e.day, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'visit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visits, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'cart_add' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carts, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'checkout_open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkouts, SUM(CASE WHEN e.name = 'order_placed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders FROM ops_events e WHERE e.day >= :fromd AND e.day <= :tod GROUP BY e.day ORDER BY e.day

title: M-Pesa transactions
desc: Every STK push attempt with outcome and receipt.
sql: SELECT m.created_at, m.order_id, m.phone, m.amount, m.status, COALESCE(m.mpesa_receipt,'') AS receipt FROM mpesa_transactions m WHERE m.created_at >= :from AND m.created_at < :to ORDER BY m.id

title: Refunds
desc: Refund requests with decision, amount and M-Pesa reference.
sql: SELECT r.id, r.created_at, r.order_id, r.name, r.reason, r.status, r.amount_req, r.amount_ok, COALESCE(r.handled_by,'') AS handled_by, COALESCE(r.mpesa_ref,'') AS mpesa_ref, r.decided_at, r.paid_at FROM ops_refunds r WHERE r.created_at >= :from AND r.created_at < :to ORDER BY r.id

title: Cash-ups
desc: Counted versus expected cash per branch per day.
sql: SELECT c.day, c.branch, c.expected, c.counted, c.variance, COALESCE(c.by_name,'') AS by_name, COALESCE(c.note,'') AS note FROM ops_cashups c WHERE c.day >= :fromd AND c.day <= :tod ORDER BY c.day, c.branch

title: Expenses
desc: Recorded expenses by date.
sql: SELECT e.expense_date, e.category, COALESCE(e.description,'') AS description, e.amount, COALESCE(e.branch,'') AS branch, COALESCE(e.paid_via,'') AS paid_via FROM expenses e WHERE e.expense_date >= :fromd AND e.expense_date <= :tod AND (:branch = '' OR e.branch = :branch) ORDER BY e.expense_date, e.id

title: Customer reviews
desc: Ratings and comments.
sql: SELECT r.created_at, r.order_id, COALESCE(r.name,'') AS name, r.rating, COALESCE(r.branch,'') AS branch, r.status, COALESCE(r.comment,'') AS comment FROM reviews r WHERE r.created_at >= :from AND r.created_at < :to ORDER BY r.id

title: Referrals
desc: Referral codes used and rewards.
sql: SELECT r.created_at, r.code, r.referrer_phone9, r.referred_phone9, COALESCE(r.referred_name,'') AS referred_name, r.status, r.paid_at FROM ops_referrals r WHERE r.created_at >= :from AND r.created_at < :to ORDER BY r.id

title: Standing orders
desc: Repeat baskets customers have set up.
sql: SELECT s.id, s.created_at, COALESCE(s.name,'') AS name, s.phone9, s.freq, s.next_date, s.status, s.fulfilment, COALESCE(s.branch,'') AS branch FROM ops_subs s WHERE s.created_at >= :from AND s.created_at < :to ORDER BY s.id

title: Franchise enquiries
desc: Everyone who applied for a franchise, with budget, premises and follow-up status.
sql: SELECT f.id, f.created_at, f.name, f.phone, COALESCE(f.email,'') AS email, f.town, f.budget, f.premises, f.timeline, f.status, COALESCE(f.handled_by,'') AS handled_by FROM ops_franchise f WHERE f.created_at >= :from AND f.created_at < :to ORDER BY f.id

title: Daily checklist log
desc: Every opening, mid-shift, closing and weekly checklist, with failed lines and who signed.
sql: SELECT r.run_date, COALESCE(b.name, r.branch) AS branch, r.code, r.status, r.done, r.total, r.fails, r.attention, CASE WHEN r.attention > 0 AND r.resolved = 1 THEN 'yes' WHEN r.attention > 0 THEN 'open' ELSE '' END AS critical_state, COALESCE(r.resolve_note,'') AS resolve_note, COALESCE(r.completed_by,'') AS completed_by FROM pb_runs r LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = r.branch WHERE r.run_date >= :fromd AND r.run_date <= :tod AND (:branch = '' OR r.branch = :branch OR b.name = :branch) ORDER BY r.run_date DESC, r.branch, r.code

title: Training and certification
desc: Quiz results and practical sign-offs per person, branch and course.
sql: SELECT t.taken_at, COALESCE(b.name, t.branch) AS branch, t.staff_name, t.staff_ref, t.course, t.score, CASE WHEN t.passed = 1 THEN 'passed' ELSE 'not passed' END AS result, CASE WHEN t.practical = 1 THEN 'signed off' ELSE '' END AS practical, COALESCE(t.practical_by,'') AS practical_by, COALESCE(t.recorded_by,'') AS recorded_by FROM pb_training t LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = t.branch WHERE t.taken_at >= :from AND t.taken_at < :to AND (:branch = '' OR t.branch = :branch OR b.name = :branch) ORDER BY t.id DESC

title: New branch launches
desc: Branches started with the wizard and whether they are live.
sql: SELECT l.id, l.created_at, l.name, l.branch_id, l.type, CASE WHEN l.grill = 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS grill, l.status, COALESCE(l.live_at,'') AS live_at, COALESCE(l.created_by,'') AS created_by FROM pb_launches l WHERE l.created_at >= :from AND l.created_at < :to ORDER BY l.id DESC

title: Purchases log
desc: Meat bought by each branch: supplier, cut, kilograms and cost.
sql: SELECT p.id, p.day, p.branch, p.supplier, p.product, p.kg, p.cost, p.ref, p.by_name FROM bo_purchases p WHERE p.day >= :fromd AND p.day <= :tod ORDER BY p.day, p.id

title: Waste log
desc: Meat thrown away or trimmed, by branch and reason.
sql: SELECT w.id, w.day, w.branch, w.product, w.kg, w.reason, w.note, w.by_name FROM bo_waste w WHERE w.day >= :fromd AND w.day <= :tod ORDER BY w.day, w.id

title: Cutting yield log
desc: Carcass or primal weighed in, saleable cuts and trim out, with the yield %.
sql: SELECT y.id, y.day, y.branch, y.product, y.kg_in, y.kg_out, y.trim_kg, ROUND(100.0 * y.kg_out / y.kg_in, 1) AS yield_pct, y.note, y.by_name FROM bo_yield y WHERE y.day >= :fromd AND y.day <= :tod ORDER BY y.day, y.id

title: Supplier rejections
desc: Meat rejected on delivery, by supplier and reason.
sql: SELECT r.id, r.day, r.branch, r.supplier, r.product, r.kg, r.reason, r.note, r.by_name FROM bo_rejects r WHERE r.day >= :fromd AND r.day <= :tod ORDER BY r.day, r.id

title: Royalty statements
desc: Franchise royalty statements issued, with status.
sql: SELECT r.id, r.period, f.name AS franchisee, f.branch_id, r.orders, r.gross, r.refunds, r.royalty_pct, r.royalty, r.marketing, r.total, r.status, COALESCE(r.paid_at,'') AS paid_at FROM bo_royalties r JOIN bo_franchisees f ON f.id = r.franchisee_id ORDER BY r.period DESC, r.id DESC

title: Marketplace partner performance
desc: Each partner's completed orders and sales in the period.
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, p.tier, COALESCE(p.hygiene_score,0) AS hygiene_score, COUNT(o.id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total),0) AS revenue FROM mk_partners p LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.partner_id = p.id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.status, p.tier, p.hygiene_score ORDER BY revenue DESC

title: Activity and audit log
desc: Tamper-evident record of sign-ins, changes and exports. Each row carries a hash that chains to the previous row.
sql: SELECT a.id, a.ts, a.category, a.action, a.actor, COALESCE(a.role,'') AS role, a.ip, COALESCE(a.target,'') AS target, COALESCE(a.detail,'') AS detail, a.outcome, a.hash FROM activity_log a WHERE a.ts >= :from AND a.ts < :to ORDER BY a.id

title: Security events
desc: Failed logins, lock-outs, attack probes and blocks.
sql: SELECT s.id, s.ts, s.sev, s.type, s.ip, COALESCE(s.actor,'') AS actor, COALESCE(s.path,'') AS path, COALESCE(s.detail,'') AS detail FROM sec_events s WHERE s.ts >= :from AND s.ts < :to ORDER BY s.id

title: Email log
desc: Messages the system sent (or failed to send) through the cPanel mailbox.
sql: SELECT e.id, e.ts, e.to_addr, e.subject, e.status, COALESCE(e.error,'') AS error, COALESCE(e.by_name,'') AS by_name FROM email_log e WHERE e.ts >= :from AND e.ts < :to ORDER BY e.id
